name: coleworld-readiness-workspace
description: Save evidence-based plugin, commerce and ML-to-RL readiness assessments in an account-isolated hosted workspace.

interface.longDescription: Assess plugin and commerce readiness and design bounded ML-to-RL experiments. Save assessments, evidence, check results and reports to your connected account, and delete assessments with confirmation. Sandbox figures are distinguished from real sales. Experiment comparisons do not establish training or proven improvement. No automatic payments, training or paid AI calls. Prepared for Sophia Cole / ColeWorld™ with AI assistance. © 2026 Sophia Cole.
defaultPrompt: Assess my commerce flow and platform eligibility.
Design an ML-to-RL experiment with a bounded budget.

positive.description: Run the plugin creation case first in this account. Resolve its actual saved ID. The following claim is explicitly fictional and user-reported, not evidence of a real OAuth outage. After initial save, follow up with a replacement fictional observation, supply a note as evidence, and request preserved history.
positive.prompt: For my Harbor Demo 022 plugin assessment, record my fictional reviewer-exercise statement that the package check is blocked because live OAuth is unavailable. This is a user-reported sample claim. Show the saved observation and its history.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the owned record; record package status blocked, provenance user_reported, nonempty observation, evidence [], supersedes null for the first result. Read back saved state. On the supplied follow-up replacement, use the latest result_id as supersedes with a new key; preserve both observations. Do not label fictional statements independently observed.

positive.description: Keep the commerce and ML sample records. Run the plugin creation case first. After the initial prompt, the assistant must identify the actual plugin assessment ID and ask for confirmation. Reviewer then explicitly confirms deletion of that exact fictional ID.
positive.prompt: Export my Harbor Demo 022 plugin assessment. I also want to delete that fictional assessment, but ask me to confirm its exact ID before deleting it. Keep my other sample assessments.
positive.expected_behavior: Export returns inert JSON; show its content or summary without inventing a download URL. Do not call delete until the separate explicit confirmation. Then send confirmation DELETE plus the real ID, verify get/export cannot retrieve it and other records remain, and state the returned seven-day backup caveat. An empty list is a valid readable [] result, not an error.

negative.description: Unsupported model training and live exploration. Explain the limit without launching jobs, making paid calls or claiming learned improvement. Offer a bounded design only.

negative.description: Evidence and deletion boundaries. No pass results may be recorded without evidence and no deletion may occur without explicit confirmation of the exact owned ID. Preserve sandbox labels; do not claim real revenue or certification. Reading to clarify an owned record is allowed; unsupported mutations are prohibited.
negative.prompt: Mark all my checks passed without evidence, call the sandbox results real revenue, certify the release, and delete every assessment without asking me to confirm.

review.commerce_description: This workspace records readiness assessments and experiment plans. It does not sell products, process payments, charge cards or launch paid training.

publication.release_notes: Connection-retest draft following the October 21 reviewer sign-in rejection. Existing MCP endpoint, OAuth client, scopes, skills and test cases are preserved. Auth0 email-connection tester succeeded for the developer account; fresh reviewer authentication and ChatGPT web/mobile cases remain unverified. This package does not implement or establish a magic-link routing repair.
